# Kuailu AI CRM | Industry Solutions

| Industry | Typical CRM Scenario | Delivery Boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Manufacturing | Leads, accounts, opportunities, quotations, orders and collections | Product and ERP integration scope must be confirmed for each project. |
| Energy and renewable resources | Account development, quotation, order, contract and collection tracking | Industry data models and workflows are configured to the agreed scope. |
| Cross-border trade | International leads, regional ownership, customer follow-up and order coordination | Data location, cross-border transfers and local compliance require project review. |
| Retail and distribution | Customer operations, sales opportunities and order analysis | Channel, membership and transaction integrations depend on available interfaces. |
| Medical equipment | Accounts, opportunities, contracts, orders and collections | Regulatory requirements and delivery scope must be validated for the target market. |
| Finance and professional services | Relationship management, opportunity governance and activity records | Access controls, audit requirements and applicable regulations require confirmation. |
